title: Secure Your Site: A Checklist for Administrators | Orchard Core
description:
Security in Orchard Core is spread over several pages of the admin, and a page can be missed when you review a site.

This checklist visits those pages in the order a person would review them, and says what to look for on each one.

In this video:
• The four questions the checklist asks, and where the pages are
• Turning on the security features your site needs
• Who can do what: roles, permissions and user accounts
• How people sign in: login settings, two-factor authentication and registration
• Protecting the connection: HTTPS, security headers and reverse proxy settings
• Stopping abuse: reCaptcha, rate limits and CORS
• Keeping records and secrets: Audit Trail and Secrets
• The checklist to review again
